title: mcp/server approval entry
description: MCP spawn approval list entry (governance dataset org.evorule.mcp.servers). Strict builtin: server_key/command/comment are always required; the approval attribution trio (approved_by/approved_at/approval_ref) is enforced by the store code gates rather than this schema, because it is status-conditional - proposal-form entries (Draft/Candidate, machine-proposed) legitimately omit it (a proposal is a request, not an approval), while promotion to Active (any path) and direct Active/Published writes require it complete (the human approve action fills it from the approver identity). server_key must equal the canonical hash of command+args_pattern; the cross-field checks live in the store write core and the Active promotion gate. entry_id convention = server_key. The executor side (agent spawn gate) mirrors this contract and aligns via shared golden vector tests.
